activation_scope: B-grade next-session human review candidates only; no order authority; new buys remain watch-only
purpose: Deterministic next-session review conditions for buy, take-profit, staged reduction, and stop decisions.

data_contract_draft.technical_price_basis: split-adjusted OHLC rescaled to latest raw close
data_contract_draft.second_quote_tolerance_rule: reject if absolute difference exceeds max(USD 0.05, 0.10% of completed close)

deterministic_definitions_draft.reclaim: completed close is above selected EMA by at least 0.10 ATR14 and above prior completed close
deterministic_definitions_draft.decisive_breach: completed close is below selected level by at least 0.25 ATR14
deterministic_definitions_draft.ema_flat: absolute EMA change over 3 completed sessions divided by ATR14 is no more than 0.10
deterministic_definitions_draft.ema_rising: (current EMA minus the same EMA 3 completed sessions earlier) divided by ATR14 is greater than 0.10
deterministic_definitions_draft.ema_falling: (current EMA minus the same EMA 3 completed sessions earlier) divided by ATR14 is less than -0.10
deterministic_definitions_draft.repeated_crossing: at least 3 sign changes in close-minus-20EMA during the prior 8 completed sessions
deterministic_definitions_draft.breakout: completed close is above prior 20-session high by at least 0.10 ATR14
deterministic_definitions_draft.breakout_acceptance: next completed close remains at or above breakout level and session low is not more than 0.25 ATR14 below it
deterministic_definitions_draft.failed_higher_high: session high exceeds prior 5-session high, closes below that prior high, and next completed close breaks the signal-session low
deterministic_definitions_draft.excessive_gap_rule: reject a new entry when absolute opening gap exceeds max(5%, 1.0 ATR14 / prior close), unless an event strategy is separately approved
deterministic_definitions_draft.overheat_rejection: high is at least 2.5 ATR14 above 20EMA, close is no more than 2.0 ATR14 above 20EMA, close is in the lower 35% of the session range, and relative volume is at least 1.2
deterministic_definitions_draft.earnings_blackout: for single stocks, no ordinary new entry from 2 completed sessions before scheduled earnings through the first completed session after results

new_entry_draft.current_portfolio_effect: watch_only because verified available cash is USD 0

take_profit_draft_for_new_trades_only.planned_r_definition: planned entry minus approved initial stop
take_profit_draft_for_new_trades_only.actual_r_definition: confirmed average fill minus unchanged approved initial stop

tranches.trigger: completed close or intraday trade reaches 1.0 actual R; review at completed session
completed close or intraday trade reaches 2.0 actual R; review at completed session
close is at least 2.5 ATR14 above 20EMA plus approved rejection or failed-higher-high confirmation
two consecutive completed closes below 10EMA, or one decisive close below 20EMA with 10EMA below 20EMA

take_profit_draft_for_new_trades_only.existing_holdings_without_recorded_initi: R-multiple targets disabled; use only separately approved absolute, EMA, or ATR rules

SOXL.hard_maximum_loss_review_formula: fresh verified average cost multiplied by (1 - approved maximum loss fraction)
SOXL.first_weakness_reduction_review: two consecutive completed closes below 10EMA while 10EMA is falling
SOXL.second_weakness_reduction_review: one decisive close below 20EMA with 10EMA below 20EMA, or failed 20EMA reclaim followed by break of signal low
SOXL.existing_position_take_profit_review: after close reaches at least 2.5 ATR14 above 20EMA and a failed-higher-high or rejection confirmation occurs; no R-multiple target is permitted

MVLL.instrument_risk: leveraged single-stock exposure; exact issuer objective must be reverified before activation
MVLL.hard_maximum_loss_review_formula: fresh verified average cost multiplied by (1 - approved maximum loss fraction)
strength_path_in_aligned_downtrend: 25% review at prior 20-session high or 2.5 ATR14 extension
remainder governed by approved technical stop or later explicit instruction
weakness_path: 25% review after two consecutive closes below falling 10EMA
25% review after decisive close below 20EMA with 10EMA below 20EMA
remaining risk review at failed reclaim or hard maximum-loss boundary

stop_draft.initial_stop_formula: highest approved price below entry among structural swing low minus 0.25 ATR14, 20EMA minus 0.75 ATR14, and existing hard maximum-loss boundary
stop_draft.gap_through_stop: human risk review at first reliable quote; never infer execution at stop
stop_draft.trading_halt: freeze signal state and escalate to human review
stop_draft.time_stop: review after 10 completed sessions when maximum favorable excursion is below 0.5 R and close is below 20EMA
stop_draft.average_cost_recalculation: only after confirmed broker fill or fresh broker snapshot

tranche_quantity_draft.anchor: confirmed shares at policy activation; never inferred from a price touch
tranche_quantity_draft.fractional_share_rule: floor each non-final tranche to whole shares with a minimum of 1 share; assign all residual shares only to the explicitly approved final tranche
tranche_quantity_draft.unlock_next_tranche: only after user-confirmed fill updates portfolio state

activation_requirements: Fresh complete broker snapshot within the active freshness window
Explicit approval of every numeric threshold and definition
Per-symbol entry eligibility and instrument verification
Per-tranche percentage or exact shares, minimum remaining shares, and stable tranche IDs
Exact reset, expiry, confirmation, and deduplication rules
Approved capital-risk fraction, concentration cap, and correlation cap
Positive verified available cash for any new buy
Regression tests and forward test pass
EMA timing branches, stable event keys, and state transitions are implemented in evaluate_alerts.py and regression-tested
Explicit user instruction to merge this proposal into alert_policy.json
known_current_blockers: Broker and position snapshot is dated 2026-07-31 and must be refreshed before quantity-dependent advice
Verified available cash is USD 0, so all new buys remain watch-only
SOXL and MVLL have no recorded versioned initial stop, so R-based existing-position take-profit is unavailable
Quantity-bearing timing reviews remain fail-closed until a fresh broker snapshot confirms that holdings still satisfy the policy anchor equation
New-buy risk budget and positive verified available cash are still absent, so buy setup detection remains watch-only
